question: The Earth Hour programme began in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2007**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Earth Hour is a global environmental movement organized by the **World Wildlife Fund (WWF)** in 2007.
 
• Earth Hour began in **Sydney, Australia**, as a small grassroots movement aiming to bring attention to **climate change.**
 
• It is observed every year on the **last Saturday of March**, from 8:30 PM to 9:30 PM local time.
 
• The theme for the Earth Hour program in 2024 is "**Give** **an** **Hour** **for** **Earth**".
